availability.join: Companyfacts accn to SEC submissions accession_number
availability.future_row_policy: abort the research if available_from is after decision_time

filings.amendment_policy: an amendment changes the state only from its own exact accepted_at; it is compared with the latest earlier fiscal-period state
filings.current_period_rule: balance-sheet components must share the filing period_of_report
filings.prior_period_rule: latest earlier fiscal period accepted before the current filing, 45 through 460 calendar days earlier
filings.debt_scope_rule: current and prior states must use the same complete debt scope

components.net_debt_to_assets: total debt less cash and cash equivalents, divided by assets

signal.name: sec_balance_sheet_resilience_event
signal.positive: both ratios are no higher than the prior comparable state and at least one is strictly lower
signal.negative: both ratios are no lower than the prior comparable state and at least one is strictly higher
signal.neutral: otherwise, including missing or incomparable component scope

source_screen.entry: first NYSE close strictly after exact accepted_at
source_screen.pass: full, OOS, and OOS2 63D positive-minus-negative spread greater than zero and OOS/OOS2 filing-week bootstrap 95% lower bound at least zero

stop_rules.underpowered_or_reject: no portfolio A/B and no retuning
stop_rules.source_screen_pass: only then preregister one fixed-book arm

pit_caveats: current identity map is not historical membership
Companyfacts tag absence is not zero debt or zero cash
foreign issuers without comparable Companyfacts remain neutral
